description: Set, unset, or replace custom metadata attributes on contacts, links and events. For emails, phones, handles, and URLs use manage_identity instead — those are routing keys, not attributes.

inputSchema.description: Set, unset, or replace attributes on contacts, links and events.

entries.description: Key-value map to replace all attributes. Required when action=replace.

value.description: Attribute value, or null for presence/tag semantics.

name.description: Attribute name. Required when action=set or unset.

removedAt.description: Removal timestamp. Optional for action=unset. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

contact.description: Contact locator. Required when kind=contact. Provide contactId or identity.

eventId.description: Target event id; provide eventId or ref.

link.description: Link locator. Required when kind=link. Provide linkId or endpoints.

value.description: Attribute value. Required when action=set. Null for presence/tag semantics.

name: manage_attribute
